choices.content: The area of \(\triangle ABD\) is greater
The area of \(\triangle ACD\) is greater

question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(AD\) is the median to side \(BC\). How do the areas of \(\triangle ABD\) and \(\triangle ACD\) compare?

solutions.explanation: The two triangles have equal bases (\(BD=CD\)) and the same height (both are the distance from \(A\) to \(BC\)), so their areas are equal.
solutions.title: Equal bases and a common height
